name: Ore no Otouto ga Konna ni k(ry
source:
The protagonist, Takayoshi, is the eldest of the three Koyama brothers. He has become a fine housekeeper, perhaps because he has been taking care of his younger brothers in place of their often absent parents. The family has a good relationship with the neighboring Nakadachi family, and they have been close since they were children.
One day, the Nakadachi's parents have to go overseas for work for a year, and Takayoshi ends up having to take care of the Nakadachi siblings as well...
translation:
主角高吉是小山三兄弟中的长子。他已经成为一名优秀的管家，也许是因为他代替经常缺席的父母照顾弟弟们。一家人与邻近的中立家关系很好，从小就关系亲密。
有一天，中立一家的父母要出国工作一年，而高吉也不得不照顾中立兄妹……
